div.div: Resume from "now" and 105–107 are lost in silence — no error, no gap, just three messages the player never sees. A sequence number per channel is what makes the gap detectable at all.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 756px; height: 1px; padding-top: 475px; margin-left: 40px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: var(--dg-warn-fg);

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; color: var(--dg-warn-fg); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Client-generated id, server-generated order. The id makes retries idempotent so the network can be as unreliable as it likes; the seq makes gaps detectable so a reconnect can be correct rather than hopeful.

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
